From: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
To: Tim Barker <tim.barker@kestrelbio.com>
Cc: Aisha Verma <aisha@kestrelbio.com>
Date: 2027-09-20T11:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor — invoice submission question

Hi Tim / Aisha — great to meet you earlier. Short answer: portal-first, email-backstop. A few implementation details below so your AP team can choose the best path: 

Portal (preferred):
- Upload to our vendor portal (we'll send the invite link once your vendor record is active).
- Advantages: automated ack, PO linkage, faster matching to PO lines, fewer manual exceptions.
- Required on upload: Redwood PO number (if a PO exists), invoice number, invoice date, net amount, tax line (if any).

Email fallback (only if portal not available):
- Send to ap-invoices@redwood.ai with subject: "Invoice: Kestrel Biotech — [Invoice #]"
- Include the PO in the body and attach the PDF. Please avoid ZIPs; PDFs preferred.
- Our parser expects line items (description, qty, unit price, line total) but we can accept single-line invoices for fixed-fee work.

I've looped Jordan Blake (AP lead) on specifics and Marissa on vendor setup. Jordan — can you confirm any PO stamping requirements / preferred subject conventions on your side?

Best,
Lauren Bishop
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai; Tim Barker <tim.barker@kestrelbio.com>
Cc: Aisha Verma <aisha@kestrelbio.com>
Date: 2027-09-21T09:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor — invoice submission question

Thanks Lauren — quick clarifications from AP: 

- PO stamping: if a PO exists, we require the PO number to be visible in the invoice header (not just the file name). That lets our matcher auto-apply.
- Subject convention for email fallback: "Invoice | Kestrel Biotech | INV-XXXX" — the pipe separators help our email parser.
- PDF requirements: legible invoice number, invoice date, vendor remit address, and at least one of these: vendor tax ID or VAT number.
- If multiple POs are billed on a single invoice, please list PO numbers in a dedicated field or table.

Operational note: our portal will automatically produce an acknowledgement and an invoice ID. If you need a paper trail for remittance, forward the portal ack to your AP inbox.

On vendor setup: Marissa, can you confirm we received the completed onboarding form? If not, I'll hold invoice processing until the vendor record is verified (standard 48–72 hour window).

Regards,
Jordan Blake
Senior AP Analyst
Redwood Inference

If you prefer to keep bank details off email, you can upload the completed form securely here (I'll turn on the portal invite once the form is complete): https://vendor-portal.redwood.com/onboarding/complete/DEAL-4892
- For your first invoice, please put the PO on the first page header and include a simple line-item table. Our OCR is tolerant but consistent formatting reduces manual review time.
